incident-bot: ALERT: oauth.token.rate_spike detected for tenant clustering across us-west-2. spike_time=2026-03-15T02:45:01Z, total_failed_intros=312, unique_client_ids=7 :warning:
Jamila (oncall): I'm paged, taking ownership. tagging @Svetlana @sec-eng-Ravi. any initial impact to customers?
Svetlana (SRE): Oncall SRE here. seeing abnormal 401/403 rates from a set of service clients. traffic shows repeated token refresh calls ~600r/s from a narrow IP range.
DevOps_Matt: I'm seeing the same from infra logs. raw snippet: ```
2026-03-15T02:44:58Z token_refresh client_id=client-42 src_ip=54.183.12.77 status=200
2026-03-15T02:45:02Z token_refresh client_id=client-42 src_ip=54.183.12.77 status=429
2026-03-15T02:45:07Z token_introspect client_id=client-88 src_ip=54.183.12.77 status=401
```
sec-eng-Ravi: tagging sec response. This looks like credential stuffing / leaked client secret usage. Do we have successful data exfil attempts (admin scopes)?
Svetlana (SRE): No sign of admin-scope escalations in the audit logs; most introspects fail or return limited scopes. But we have a handful of successful token refreshes earlier. pulling list of affected client_ids now.
incident-bot: Affected_clients: [client-14, client-42, client-88, client-129]. Recommend immediate short-term mitigations: 1) rotate client secrets for affected clients, 2) block src_ip range 54.183.12.0/24 at edge, 3) rate-limit token endpoints for suspect clients.
Jamila (oncall): Agreed. I will coordinate rotation for client-42 and client-88. @DevOps_Matt can you push an emergency WAF rule to block the /oauth/token path for that IP range? Use a 10m temporary block.
DevOps_Matt: Pushing rule now. command: ```curl -X POST https://waf-api.internal/rules -d '{"path":"/oauth/token","ip_cidr":"54.183.12.0/24","action":"block","duration":"10m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>'``` returning 202. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: WAF rule 8921 applied to global edge, expires in 10m.
sec-eng-Ravi: For rotations: prepare new secrets and rotate in gateway with a dual-write (old + new) window then hard-revoke old after 5 minutes of canary. Also update our public docs and client-config central store. I'll create a short runbook.
DevOps_Matt: Preparing secrets in Secrets Manager. command to create new secret (example): ```aws secretsmanager create-secret --name /clients/client-42/secret --secret-string '---REDACTED---'```
Jamila (oncall): Nora from CS, any inbound tickets tied to these clients?
Nora (Customer Success): Yes, ACME reported intermittent 401s around 02:46Z. They sent a support dump; we should brief them if rotation will cause longer downtime.
Jamila (oncall): We'll do a rolling rotate with canary on staging first to avoid broad outages. Plan: 1) Create new secret for client-42, 2) update gateway to accept new secret alongside old, 3) monitor error rate for 5m, 4) revoke old secret, 5) notify CS. Estimated time 15-20m.
Svetlana (SRE): Can we triage whether compromised clients are credential leaks vs. client-side compromise? Look at user-agent patterns and geo distribution.
sec-eng-Ravi: Good call. Initial heuristics: same UA string across different client_ids + same src_ip cluster -> likely automated script using stolen secrets. Will investigate repo access and recent API key issuance.
Jamila (oncall): Assign tasks: @DevOps_Matt rotate client-42 and client-88 (high priority). @sec-eng-Ravi investigate leak vector. @Svetlana monitor SLOs & error rates. I'll own comms with CS and PD.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by oncall. Severity set to SEV2 (potential customer impact). Paging Slack channel #incident-war-room.
DevOps_Matt: client-42 secret created, gateway config patched to accept new secret (dual-write). canary traffic looks good.
Svetlana (SRE): Error rate for client-42 dropped from 420r/s to 15r/s after WAF + rotate. Telemetry: token_introspect_failures down 92%.
sec-eng-Ravi: Preparing rotation commands for client-129 and client-14 next. We'll stagger by 5m to reduce churn. Also collecting list of service accounts to hard revoke if we see unknown scopes.
Nora (Customer Success): I'll send a targeted note to ACME: "We're investigating auth anomalies affecting a subset of service integrations; we've applied mitigations and are rotating credentials for affected clients. Expect brief reauth windows. We'll update in 30m."
Jamila (oncall): Good. After rotations finish, we should rotate any long-lived tokens and issue a security advisory if we confirm secret exposure. Schedule postmortem in 48h.
infra-bot: IP block 54.183.12.0/24 still active (expires in 7m).
incident-bot: ACTIONS: WAF block, rotated secrets for client-42 & client-88, staggered rotate for client-14 & client-129 in progress, CS notified, PD escalated.
Jamila (oncall): Closing immediate mitigation window. We'll keep thread open for follow-up findings. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
